answer: A farm faking 294 aliases needs 294 separate session records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Bridge congress membership with duplicate session record is the check: sessions played at congresses for years. The tundra check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The thread record is public, the willow cost is per identity, and 294 aliases cost 294 times one honest seat.
